steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: What's the situation?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Areas D and E have been severely damaged, and the structures in other areas have sustained various degrees of damage as well!

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Nineteen people have light injuries, with nobody seriously injured as of yet.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Fortunately, we followed the instructions given by you and the Doctor, and managed to move most of them to a safe area ahead of time––

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: No, nowhere's safe right now.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Everywhere around you is dangerous... Our entire stronghold has been completely exposed to the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: They're not going to stop until they've blasted this place into smithereens to make sure we have nowhere to hide.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: How much time do we have?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Thirty minutes. Uhh, maybe even less than that.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The nearby plates are pretty old, and if we take the power of the artillery we've seen before and multiply that by the theoretical maximum output value––

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: We won't even have thirty minutes before the structure above us collapses right onto our heads!

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Let Harmo know and we'll start the train right away.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Train?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: You all should've seen it before. A few kilometers above us is a train station.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I thought all the stations were occupied by the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Then all we have to do is take that one back.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Now that the Sarkaz have cut off all our pathways to other boroughs, this is the last chance we have to evacuate Sudean.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Heidi, once we leave Sudean, do you have a way to keep us out of sight?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Yes. I've been preparing for this.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Once we arrive at the next station, we'll have friends who will disguise us until we successfully enter Central Londinium.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: The biggest question mark will be whether or not we can safely board the train––

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Clovisia, how far are we from the city walls?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Very close, if we take the underground passages.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'd like to try climbing them from beneath.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Amiya, are you planning to...?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We'll buy time for the Self-Salvation Corps to retreat.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Block all exits from the targeted plate and keep an eye on the train station. I don't want them crawling into the next gutter over.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Set up the motion-tracking ground targeting system. In case they still have some fight left in them and plan to escape through the surface via vehicle, we'll greet them with even more intense fire.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Strengthen the defenses of all points inside the city walls.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Also, change the control passwords for the defense artillery so no one but me can deactivate it.
Good, you're taking adequate precautions.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: General?! You're here...?

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: In a matter of moments, these pesky insects have nowhere to hide. The Londinium rebels will never again dare to poke their heads out.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: More importantly, nobody will be able to go in and out of the dark passages we cannot see. The only thing the dukes outside will hear will be our hand-picked messages.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: No one will interfere with our project's progress again.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Manfred, am I not welcome to share this moment of triumph with you?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Please do not mock me so, Your Highness.

steps.name: Theresis?
steps.text: Oh? You've gotten better than before. We hardly spoke five sentences, and you've already realized we are not Theresis.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Your Highness... Whether or not His Majesty is willing to turn a blind eye to you, should you draw the attention of the Confessarii, they will surely petition His Majesty to restrict your movements.

steps.name: Theresis?
steps.text: Very well. As you said, the Military Commission cannot allow two men to call the shots––
In that case, I'll shift to an appearance I'm more comfortable with.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: How unusual that you're willing to meet with me using the same appearance you take at the Royal Court.
We vowed not to use the faces of the dead, so as to not scare you and your men.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You came back sooner than expected.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Even though you helped us root out the rebels' den, they may still have an escape route I haven't found.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: If you could uphold your end of the deal and follow them until every last rebel has fallen into our hands...
Do you really think that Doctor can keep us hidden for so long?
More importantly, Manfred, you must not forget that we do not belong to you.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I was out of line. Please forgive me.
Don't talk to us the same way you do to old pink-eyes. We've told you before, we won't fall for that drivel.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: As you wish, Your Highness.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Since you decided to come back ahead of time, did you find what you were looking for underground?
Hmm... That 'King of Sarkaz' is stronger than we thought, but is far from mature.
She knows little of what she is about to face. If we want to learn more about her, that will have to wait until she meets Her Majesty.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You'd better not let the Confessarii hear those words.
And why not?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: They'll think the Damazti Cluster of the Royal Court... had a change of heart.
And why would you think that matters to us?
Manfred, we've already done what we promised you. You and the vampire can clean up the rest of the mess yourselves.
Oh, right... Next time we speak, pick an identity for us that is still alive.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Vina, Amiya and the Doctor have already left.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: The first wave of Self-Salvation Corps forces are rushing towards the station above us.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Hurry, pick up the pace!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Once they capture the station, injured troops and non-combatant civilians will be the first to board the train.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Mr. Balin, can I trouble you and the medics to tend to the injured with restricted mobility? Everyone, please pay attention to the signal lights on both sides of the passage, and don't get lost!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Most of the command structure will go with the injured and the civilians, except––

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Have all our people entered the retreat channel?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: The integrity of the superstructure is continuing to erode! Commander, we have to get out of here quick!

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: As long as everyone's inside, I'll be right behind you!

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: 12th, sitrep!

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Commander, the underground areas won't hold for much longer. Are enemies really still coming down?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Report!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Vina, should we go with Balin's group?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We're staying.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Staying? You're going to stay here with Commander Clovisia?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I have a feeling... Maybe she's getting it too.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The strongest enemy... might not be above us right now.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: The cannons.

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: Horn, the defensive cannons are activating again! This time, they're targeting the plate closest to the city walls. From what I can tell, they're not aiming at us...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: But there's no guarantee that the surrounding areas are safe.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Run, hurry––

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Where's my daughter? Has anyone seen my daughter!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Look out!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Get inside the sturdiest building as quickly as you can! ––No, get away from the city walls, now!

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: O-Okay...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: So this... is Londinium's defensive artillery.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Based on the current situation, it won't be long until the cannon fire penetrates the plate and destroys the base structure.

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: Those damned Sarkaz... Is this the moment they've been waiting for? Are they trying to destroy the city?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: No. They've only activated a small number of cannons, and their targets are quite clear.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: They're trying to eradicate us... and our friends.

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: Horn, what should we do?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Among the soldiers who came back with us yesterday, how many of them were originally part of the city's defense forces garrisoned here?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Call them over. Bring the best equipment we've got.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Tell them–– it's time to take back these walls from the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We're almost there.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Careful, don't trip and fall––

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Are you hanging in there?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: *sigh*... It's hard to say.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Yeah, I know where you're coming from.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I've also made the big mistake of trusting people I shouldn't.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: After that, for an entire month, it took everything I had to force myself to keep going.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: As soon as I stopped, I... Well, I'd feel like I couldn't look Amiya in the eye.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Well, the battle's not over yet.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: People don't have enough time to catch their breaths. It'd be too much of a luxury for me to mourn or wallow in self-doubt.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. Feist, do you need help? I can calm you down.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: How? Is that some sort of Originium Arts?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Something like that.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: So... do you also help your men with psychological treatment, under normal circumstances?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If the operator thinks it's necessary.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Ugh...

options: Relax. Amiya's looking out for all of you.
Amiya won't see our people become cold war machines.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. Feist, did I come off the wrong way?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: No, no, that's not it. I was just thinking you have some truly amazing Arts.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Even in a big place like Londinium, I've hardly seen anything like them before.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Miss Amiya, I appreciate your kindness. But, I don't think I'm ready to drive that scene out of my head so quickly.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Then we'll just have to get right back to work.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Let's do it.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The drones are showing that the defense structure layer above us is... very thick.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Can it be blown up?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Not likely. If Londinium's defenses could get blown up so easily... Well, let's just say, we would've stormed the Shard yesterday.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I appreciate that, Doctor. You sure know how to twist your employees' arms.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Hmm... I've finished scanning the lift, and as long as you guys can open up enough of a gap for me to push the drone through, I should be able to hack into the lift and take control of it.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Of course, you'll have to find a bigger gap to get yourselves up first.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Doctor, don't you think you should send a signal and call Misery over?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Fine, I guess we'll have to do it ourselves.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Maybe the locals over here can give me some inspiration.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: If you can locate the support structure and apply an extremely strong external force, you might be able to open a little seam...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Someone's rapidly approaching our location!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Did the Sarkaz expect us to find a way to climb up the wall?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Who cares about that? I'll have the drone pack some Originium explosives!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Feist, calculate the position. I'll think of some way to amplify the explosive effect––

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: He's here!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ....Hoederer.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: We meet again, leader of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What happened to W...?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Are you sure you should be worrying about her right now? I heard you folks were short on time.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm willing to set aside whatever happened between you two. As well as... what happened at Chernobog, with Scout...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But, Mr. Mercenary, if you intend on standing in our way, I'll cut you down without mercy.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: For any mercenary, dying at the hands of Her Majesty's heir would be a great honor.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: You'd better hurry up, Amiya!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The bomb I planted just started ticking down––

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: One minute! That's all the time we've got!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'll stop Hoederer...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: No... Miss Amiya, let me handle this mercenary.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. Feist?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I've found the support column. Plus, I have a plan, though I don't know how solid it is... If it works out, you and the Doctor need to seize the opportunity to get up the wall.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I know you, young warrior.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I also know that look in your eyes. The weight of everything you've lost has finally begun to set in, and you've lost your ability to trust in the soundness of your own decisions.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Lost?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Sorry, but even if I had the time, I'm not interested in a heart-to-heart with a butcher.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Over here––!

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Another smoke bomb?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Even if I'm short a usable arm, your little tricks won't work on me.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Come on, Sarkaz. Give me your worst!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Let me taste your sword, your machete, whatever weapons you've got on you––

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Trying to draw me away? Not a very sensible strategy.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Empty bravado with no self-awareness isn't going to buy you any miracles.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Even if all your men were here, you wouldn't stand a chance against me.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Pretty ugly run there. Without help, you're going to bleed out soon enough.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: After all, you're just a craftsman... You and your men wave around wrenches and hammers, and hope that is enough to hold back Sarkaz blades tempered by centuries of war?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Beg the King of Sarkaz for help. Have her deal with me.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: The King of Sarkaz?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: What... are you talking about...?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Sarkaz... You're the ones who brought war to Londinium.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: This is a war between us!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Thirty seconds!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hold on tight, Doctor!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. Feist, I need your location––

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Mercenary... Are you seeing this?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Another flashy toy? Stop resisting. You can't fool me.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Sure, you're right––

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Please, one last push!

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: A metal crab? A mechanical toy? What's your play here? Quit screwing around.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: No, that's the most important thing you've taken from me.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I've never fought alone...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Look, Old Bill helped me out again. It's all thanks to your paranoia, mercenary.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: My paranoia? You...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You're using my––!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Ha... Haha! Do you finally get it now?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Every time you swung your blade at me... you were carving your path to defeat!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Amiya, Hoederer cut through the structural layer!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Hurry, take aim! The bomb's about to blow!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Three... Two... One––

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hrrgh––

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: It's been split open! That's a big enough gap! Alright, you're up, drone––

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The lift is ours now!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, let's head up!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Feist, are you hanging in there? Grab onto the zipline, and we'll head up after them––

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You're not going anywhere!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Closure, have any more explosives?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Yeah, catch!

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Thanks for the hand, mercenary.
